title: [Shopify] Make codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" public
summary: Codeunit 30272 "Shpfy Update Price Source" is now public, allowing partners to reference it for custom Shopify price calculation logic through explicit bind/unbind subscriptions.
key_points: Access on codeunit 30272 changes from Internal to Public
Partners handling OnBeforeCalculateUnitPrice can bind this codeunit so the pricing engine uses the Shop's currency, VAT and discount settings
The codeunit only reads non-sensitive Shop configuration
EventSubscriberInstance is Manual, so subscriptions stay inactive until a partner binds them
